_help: Manual corrections applied after every sync. 'match' is a piece of the title (case and punctuation are ignored).
first: lab members who are first or co-first authors when author order alone doesn't show it.
corresponding: lab members who are corresponding authors when OpenAlex misses it.
hide: titles to drop (duplicates, abstracts you don't want listed, other people's patents).
not_lab: a co-author was wrongly matched to a lab member (same name), e.g. { "match": "title", "members": ["Hyerim Kim"] }.
type: force a type (journal, conference, patent, preprint).
topics: set research-area tags by hand, e.g. { "match": "title", "topics": ["co2", "ml"] }. Ids: co2, biomass, plastic, dft, ml, process.
extra: items that exist nowhere online.
